PASS security synchronous response durable then exact Off and security readback
PASS security async exact returned job persisted and settled
PASS security pending reconciles original job without second submission
PASS lost security reply remains consumed without readback or retry
PASS failed durable security response cannot acknowledge or query
PASS security intent persistence failure prevents provider invocation
PASS wrong ownership lineage refuses security mutation
PASS changed Off state refuses before security intent
PASS missing or false TPM security readback cannot acknowledge
PASS original deadline or admission refusal prevents security mutation
PASS security job incarnation change remains held
PASS provider refusal and terminal errors never become configured
PASS aborted or multiple-run jobs cannot authorize security completion
PASS returned replacement VM or remote job refused and retained
PASS completed security digest bound to original response and no release
